(2) The scene cuts to an outdoor street in Japan where a large crowd of people, mostly dressed in thick winter coats and scarves, stand in a queue in front of a red storefront with a large circular sign for Ichiran Ramen, while the camera pans across the architectural details of the urban buildings. (4) The man is seen interacting with a large digital touchscreen ordering kiosk inside a Japanese restaurant, where his finger selects various food icons and buttons labeled with Japanese characters, while the background shows typical restaurant interior elements like wooden tables and overhead menu boards. (5) In the final phase, the man changes into a black and white horizontal-striped shirt and eats from a larger white bowl of curry and rice, showing a highly satisfied facial expression with his eyes closed and a wide grin, as pink animated heart emojis float around his head.
